mapper.insert: INSERT INTO focus_session (user_id, client_id, task_id, habit_id, task_title, note, mode, planned_sec, started_at, ended_at, duration_sec, paused_sec, status, source, session_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{clientId}, #{taskId}, #{habitId}, #{taskTitle}, #{note}, #{mode}, #{plannedSec}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{durationSec}, #{pausedSec}, #{status}, #{source}, #{sessionDate})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM focus_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND client_id = #{clientId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM focus_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM focus_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND started_at < #{to} AND ended_at > #{from} ORDER BY started_at LIMIT 1000
SELECT task_title FROM focus_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND task_title <> '' GROUP BY task_title ORDER BY MAX(started_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE focus_session SET task_id = #{taskId}, habit_id = #{habitId}, task_title = #{taskTitle}, note = #{note}, started_at = #{startedAt}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, duration_sec = #{durationSec}, paused_sec = #{pausedSec}, session_date = #{sessionDate}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version = #{version}
UPDATE focus_session SET deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration_sec), 0) AS totalSec, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mode = 'countdown' AND status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pomodoroCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abortedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT session_date) AS activeDays FROM focus_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND session_date >= #{from} AND session_date <= #{to}

SELECT session_date AS `date`, COALESCE(SUM(duration_sec), 0) AS totalSec, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mode = 'countdown' AND status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pomodoroCount FROM focus_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND session_date >= #{from} AND session_date <= #{to} GROUP BY session_date ORDER BY session_date

SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(session_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS `date`, COALESCE(SUM(duration_sec), 0) AS totalSec, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mode = 'countdown' AND status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pomodoroCount FROM focus_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND YEAR(session_date) = #{year} GROUP BY `date` ORDER BY `date`

SELECT COALESCE(t.title, h.name, NULLIF(fs.task_title, ''), '未关联任务') AS taskTitle, COALESCE(SUM(fs.duration_sec), 0) AS totalSec, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fs.mode = 'countdown' AND fs.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pomodoroCount, COUNT(*) AS sessionCount FROM focus_session fs LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = fs.task_id AND t.user_id = fs.user_id LEFT JOIN habit h ON h.id = fs.habit_id AND h.user_id = fs.user_id WHERE fs.user_id = #{userId} AND fs.deleted_at IS NULL AND fs.session_date >= #{from} AND fs.session_date <= #{to} GROUP BY COALESCE(t.title, h.name, NULLIF(fs.task_title, ''), '未关联任务') ORDER BY totalSec DESC, MAX(fs.started_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
